text: its not just placing it. its moving things around, deleting them, making them do back flips and side flips lol you see what i mean. if we only approach it from the making sure it instantly places thats cool i can place at hyperspeed and then arrange and skin it like a shit eater so its an all or none type of ordeal
resolution: Built the FULLRES residency vertical end to end (see req_1911): the /editor route loads the WHOLE cooked-asset catalog into the loader as resident meshes on entry + on cooked-catalog change, so every Studio-compiled asset is placeable/movable/rotatable/deletable/skinnable INSTANTLY off the live-ref path with zero world rebake — the all-or-none whole-edit-loop the user demanded, delivered via the residency keystone. JS buildResidentMeshCatalogLump encodes the catalog as a MESH_PROPS lump; LoaderIsoView pushes it via __compiled_world_set_resident_meshes; the loader decodes once per gen (same decodeMeshProps as the gamefile) and meshForHash resolves a live ref against baked THEN resident meshes so a never-baked asset draws. Compile stays the lean /compiled ship path, out of the edit loop. Hash link verified (fnv1aHash(asset.meshRef) == liveMeshHash(asset.meshRef)); framework compiles ReleaseFast; streaming render proof GREEN; MESH_PROPS v7 round-trip passes. Live by-feel check needs a dev-host restart (Zig changed). SHA eb6b03b04.
